name: Confirmation: BTC regime and coin trend

sections.hypothesis: An altcoin held only while BTC closes above its 50-day average and the coin is up over 30 days, sized to 50% annual volatility, beats holding the same coin on Sharpe after costs, on most coins it was never searched on.
sections.rationale: Who pays: altcoins are leveraged bets on the crypto market's mood. When BTC's trend breaks, risk appetite leaves the small coins first and hardest, and late holders sell into falling prices; a coin's own trend shows whether money is still arriving. Stepping aside in both cases avoids most of the long declines that wiped out most altcoins (time-series momentum, Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen 2012; volatility scaling, Moreira and Muir 2017). Where it came from: the exploration half (research/exploration/log.md). In round 2 it beat holding on 83% of the 181 exploration coins and in both halves of their history on 65%, a plateau across nearby settings; on the real engine it beat holding on 37 of a 40-coin sample. Every one of those numbers was found by searching, so none is evidence. Disclosure: holding most altcoins lost about 90% in 2020-25, so beating them on Sharpe is a low bar; the test compares Sharpe, not return, so a strategy that merely holds less can't pass it on that alone.
sections.rules: btc-regime-trend with its defaults, one coin at a time, daily bars, spot, long only: at each close, in the market only while btc_close is above its 50-day average and the coin's close is above its close 30 days earlier; then weight = min(1, 50% / the coin's annualised volatility of its last 30 daily log returns), else cash. Unknown averages, volatility or BTC: cash. Decide at the close, trade at the next open; 2% no-trade band. Every confirmation-half coin with 24+ months before 2025-11-01, from its first bar.
sections.falsification: Pre-registered (CLAUDE.md, Exploration experiment), run once with kestrel confirm on every confirmation-half coin with 24+ months of daily bars before 2025-11-01: PASS only if (1) the strategy's Sharpe after costs beats holding the same coin on more than half of those coins, and (2) across every coin's walk-forward test windows pooled (24-month training, 6-month tests, the fixed rule), it beats holding's Sharpe in more than half; a coin too short for one 24 + 6-month window adds no windows but still counts for (1). Otherwise FAIL. The method itself works if at least one of the two graduates passes. A pass is not a pursue: the graduate would still need its own scorecard and holdout note.
sections.parameters: btc_days 50, coin_days 30, vol_days 30, target_vol_pct 50: chosen in exploration, fixed here. No other setting is run on the confirmation half.
sections.costs: Daily bars, 330 USDT; costs from kestrel.toml: 7.5 bps fee a side and each coin's spread band from its 30-day median daily volume (8-15 bps a side for most altcoins). One look in the confirmation trial pool; nothing here counts in the main luck bar. Turnover in exploration was about 25 times equity a year, so costs are real; they are included in every Sharpe.

history.reason: PASSED its pre-registered confirmation (2026-11-16): beat holding on 149 of 180 unsearched coins, 427 of 771 walk-forward windows.
